{{Quote|One of my men, a small, excitable fellow named Briggs, I think, travelled down a service tube and managed to rip the negative coupling out of the engine system.|General Airen Cracken|<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>}}
'''Briggs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] resistance fighter who worked with [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. Briggs and several others under Cracken's command were imprisoned in the hold of a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] by [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] men. The group found a [[positive flow detonator]] in the hold, and Briggs accessed the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] system via a service tube and took a [[negative power coupler]]. They intended to create a bomb by fusing the two together and blast a hole in the side of the ship. Lots were drawn to see who would try to detonate the jury-rigged explosive, and a man named [[D'kar]] was chosen. The plan worked, but D'kar was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the explosion with the rest escaped.
